messages.subject: growth models synthax
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

I am building models for prediction of continuos outcome variable (FEV1) and trying to assess impact of binary predictors on the outcome variable, i.e. gender.
As a newbie, I'm not that confident in my synthax, and want to double-check if anyone would like to advise me on that.

model1 = 'intercept =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4 
slope =~ 0*x1 + 1*x2 + 2*x3 + 3*x4
x1 ~~ a*x1
x2 ~~ a*x2
x3 ~~ a*x3
x4 ~~ a*x4
'
fit1 = growth(model1, data = for_lavaan, cluster='gender')
summary(fit1)

Appreciate any inputs,
Sincerely,
Dmitrii

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: growth models synthax
parts:
cluster = "gender" is not ok. The cluster= argument should only used if
you have hierarchical (or 'clustered') data (think students in classes).

If you want to assess the impact of gender, you can either use it as a
covariate in your model, or you can fit the model separately for males
and females in a multigroup model, using group = "gender".

Yves.

messages.subject: Re: growth models synthax
parts:
> model1 = 'intercept =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4
> slope =~ 0*x1 + 1*x2 + 2*x3 + 3*x4
> x1 ~~ a*x1
> x2 ~~ a*x2
> x3 ~~ a*x3
> x4 ~~ a*x4
> '
> fit1 = growth(model1, data = for_lavaan, group='gender')
> summary(fit1)

In this model, you fit the same model separately for each level of gender.

> *option 2*

> model2 = 'intercept =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4
> slope =~ 0*x1 + 1*x2 + 2*x3 + 3*x4
> intercept ~ gender
> slope ~ gender
> x1 ~~ a*x1
> x2 ~~ a*x2
> x3 ~~ a*x3
> x4 ~~ a*x4
> '
> fit2 = growth(model2, data = for_lavaan)
> summary(fit2)

In this model, gender is a predictor of the intercept and slope growth
components.

Both options are reasonable, but they reflect very different hypotheses.

Yves.
